rules.offset_selection: development counter_lag_diagnostic score lag=0 anchor_offset; no refit
rules.memory: exact pre/post counters; any nonfinite or unequal duplicate position invalid; no interpolation
rules.pixel: each confident q separately; pairwise conflicting stable duplicate counter invalidates all
rules.unknown: unstable bracket, conflicting pixel duplicate, or ANY missing/conflicting memory in full +/-8 window
rules.candidate: all exact memory frames with Euclidean norm(q-offset-memory)<=2px, inclusive
rules.relative_error: candidate memory minus reference-counter memory; component and radial hull, not continuous support
rules.future_label: diagnostic only: complete nonempty set and maximum reference-relative displacement <= fixed inflation budget

disclosure: round6 confirmation bank aggregates already exposed; not a new independent blind confirmation; new clips required for future rule validation
relative_frame_convention: candidate memory frame minus stable pre/post reference counter; negative means earlier memory
window_limit: sets only cover +/-8; no assertion that physical display frame lies in this window
interval_warning: hulls summarize discrete observed candidate sets; not interpolated positions, probability intervals, or guaranteed physical bounds
